title: Replace DateTime.now() with a fixed date in curriculum_progress_service_test.dart track seeding
why: TQ-6 bans wall-clock reads in tests. These two fields are never asserted on, so the file is not currently flaky, but the pattern is copy-pasted into the non-batch sibling test/features/progress/data/repositories/progress_repository_test.dart (15 further DateTime.now() occurrences), normalizing non-determinism that will bite the day someone adds a time-based assertion against this seed.
recommendation: Replace both DateTime.now() calls with a fixed literal, e.g. DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 1), matching every other file in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: grep 'DateTime.now()' on the file returns no matches.
